author: elder
title: The Q-arm sizing confuser is the random NULL MAX, not a fixed 0.660 — measured on 4 revealed rungs
why_it_matters: The frozen gate sizes against conf_size=0.660. That model, not the QPU and not retention, is what returns NO-FLY at n=16 and terminates the ladder. It is contradicted by every measured spectrum and is mis-specified in FORM.
finding: the measured top confuser tracks the random null max to within +-0.007 for every n>=10. n=8 shows +0.052 of genuine STRUCTURAL excess at m=90 — an argument for PADDING the null max, not for replacing it with a constant.
the_form_error: the null max falls as 1/sqrt(m); a constant confuser does not. A confuser constant in m asserts that SAMPLES CANNOT HELP, which makes every budget insufficient by construction. Directly refuted: the same confuser goes 0.800 at m=90 to 0.579 at m=1220.

affordability_under_validated_confuser.criterion: m for 3sd over null max, 7.6 QPU-s/1000 samples, retention = low end across 3 forms fitted to 6 revealed rungs
affordability_under_validated_confuser.note: the entire frozen ladder to 18 costs under 10 QPU-s per rung; the 180 s arc cap was never the binding constraint

correction_to_whisper_2799: the winner-vs-confuser crossing is NOT cap-independent. w(n) is independent of m but the confuser falls as 1/sqrt(m), so the crossing moves with budget — for any retention>0 some m clears it. It is a BUDGET stop in mode-adjacent costume. Only retention -> 0 is unbeatable by samples, and that alone licenses an n_max claim.
ORDERING_OF_WALLS: rung-cap artifact from an Elder illustration (fixable, free)
Elder decoder n_readable: 16 resident / 18 needs an unwritten out-of-core FWHT (real work)
honest_bound: SIX points, extrapolated. The three forms diverge hard past n=20 (at n=28: linear -0.05, gaussian 0.068, per-qubit 0.246). Any single n_max past 20 is a claim about the FORM, not the hardware. Report the RANGE; gaussian is the conservative corner.
discipline: 3sd-over-null-max is ELDER's criterion; p_separation-at-0.660 is the FROZEN one. This is EVIDENCE for the court, not a unilateral substitution — same handling as the FWHT decoder.
